alphabet.name: Korean Alphabet (Hangul)
alphabet.consonants: ㄱ ㄴ ㄷ ㄹ ㅁ ㅂ ㅅ ㅇ ㅈ ㅊ ㅋ ㅌ ㅍ ㅎ
alphabet.consonants_latin: g/k n d/t r/l m b/p s ng j ch k t p h
alphabet.vowels: ㅏ ㅑ ㅓ ㅕ ㅗ ㅛ ㅜ ㅠ ㅡ ㅣ
alphabet.vowels_latin: a ya eo yeo o yo u yu eu i
alphabet.note: Hangul was created in 1443 by King Sejong. It has 14 basic consonants and 10 basic vowels, combined into syllable blocks. Very systematic and easy to learn.
alphabet.syllable_structure: Each syllable block = initial consonant + vowel (+ optional final consonant).
